subtitle_id: Sistem Multi-Agent Otonom untuk Analisis Finansial, Sentimen Pasar & Portofolio
subtitle_en: Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Financial Analysis, Sentiment & Portfolio Intelligence
description_id: Arsitektur multi-agent otonom yang memecah riset investasi kompleks ke dalam beberapa agent terspesialisasi: News Sentiment Scraper Agent, Technical Indicator Calculator Agent, dan Portfolio Advisory Agent. Dibangun dengan backend Python FastAPI dan UI TypeScript interaktif.
description_en: Autonomous multi-agent architecture decomposing complex financial research into specialized cooperating agents: News Sentiment Scraper, Technical Indicator Calculator, and Portfolio Advisor Agent. Built with Python FastAPI backend and responsive TypeScript UI.
architecture_id:
1. Sistem Multi-Agent Orchestration

  • Research Agent: Scrape berita emiten IDX real-time dan analisis sentimen berita.
  • Technical Agent: Menghitung moving averages, RSI, MACD, dan sinyal breakout.
  • Synthesizer Agent: Menggabungkan hasil analisis multi-agent menjadi rekomendasi portofolio terstruktur.

2. Microservices Architecture

  • Backend (BE): Python FastAPI dengan asynchronous agent task queue.
  • Frontend (UI): TypeScript modern chat & card interface untuk interaksi dinamis pengguna.
architecture_en:
1. Multi-Agent Orchestration

  • Research Agent: Real-time IDX corporate news scraping and NLP sentiment analysis.
  • Technical Agent: Computes moving averages, momentum indicators (RSI, MACD), and breakout signals.
  • Synthesizer Agent: Fuses multi-agent findings into a cohesive, structured portfolio thesis.

2. Microservices Architecture

  • Backend: Python FastAPI with asynchronous execution and structured agent outputs.
  • Frontend: TypeScript modern responsive dashboard for agent step inspection.
